final:
I set up the cantilevered slab and it passes validation (`ok: true`); I haven't run the solve.

- **Design space:** 150 mm out from the wall (x) × 20 mm thick (y, up) × 200 mm wide (z), steel (E = 210 GPa, ν = 0.3).
- **Mesh:** 2 mm elements, giving 75 × 10 × 100 = 75,000 elements. Volume fraction is 0.3.
- **Support:** the whole wall face at x = 0 is fixed in all directions (1,111 nodes).
- **Load:** 6,000 N straight down (−y), shared equally over every node of the top face at y = 20 (7,676 nodes).

The check gave one warning: 1.3% of the load lands on the top-edge nodes at the wall. Those nodes are also fixed, so that part of the load goes straight into the support and doesn't load the slab. I left it as is, because the brief says the load covers the whole top surface. The render shows the support and load where the brief puts them.

DONE. Assumptions:
- The load is applied equally per node over the whole top face, so the 1.3% at the wall edge goes straight into the support.
- Steel is E = 210 GPa, ν = 0.3.
